MAIL_UNAVAILABLE.en: Email is temporarily unavailable. Please email info@siteleveled.com.

MAIL_FAILED.en: Your message could not be sent. Please try again or email info@siteleveled.com.

FORM_LIMIT.sk: Za krátky čas prišlo z vášho pripojenia priveľa správ. Skúste to o hodinu alebo napíšte na info@siteleveled.com.
FORM_LIMIT.en: Too many messages from your connection in a short time. Please try again in an hour or email info@siteleveled.com.

CAPTCHA_FAILED.sk: Nepodarilo sa overiť, že formulár posielate vy a nie robot. Skúste ho odoslať znova alebo napíšte na info@siteleveled.com.
CAPTCHA_FAILED.en: We couldn't confirm that this form was sent by a person. Please send it again or email info@siteleveled.com.

URL_PROTOCOL.en: Only HTTP and HTTPS websites are supported.

URL_CREDENTIALS.en: The address must not contain login credentials.

URL_PORT.en: Only standard web ports are supported.

URL_DOMAIN.en: Enter a website domain, such as example.com.

URL_DNS.sk: Doménu sa nepodarilo nájsť. Skontroluj, či je adresa správna.
URL_DNS.en: The domain could not be found. Check the address.

URL_BLOCKED.sk: Túto adresu nie je možné skontrolovať.

AUDIT_BUSY.sk: Práve prebieha veľa auditov. Skúste to o pár minút.
AUDIT_BUSY.en: The audit queue is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.

AUDIT_EXPIRED.sk: Audit sa nenašiel alebo už vypršal.
AUDIT_EXPIRED.en: This audit was not found or has expired.

AUDIT_RESTARTED.sk: Audit bol prerušený reštartom servera. Spustite ho prosím znova.
AUDIT_RESTARTED.en: The audit was interrupted by a server restart. Please start it again.

AUDIT_TIMEOUT.sk: Audit trval príliš dlho a bol zastavený. Skúste to prosím neskôr.
AUDIT_TIMEOUT.en: The audit took too long and was stopped. Please try again later.

AUDIT_START_FAILED.en: The audit could not be started.

AUDIT_UNREACHABLE.sk: Web sa nepodarilo skontrolovať. Je verejne dostupný?
AUDIT_UNREACHABLE.en: The website could not be checked. Is it publicly accessible?

AUDIT_ROBOTS.sk: Web neumožnil automatickú kontrolu (pravdepodobne blokuje roboty). Skúste inú adresu alebo nám napíšte.
AUDIT_ROBOTS.en: The website did not allow automated checks. It may block bots. Try another address or email us.

AUDIT_RESULT.en: The audit results could not be loaded.

AUDIT_LIMIT.sk: Denný limit auditov pre vašu IP adresu je vyčerpaný. Ďalší audit môžete spustiť o {wait}.
AUDIT_LIMIT.en: The daily audit limit for your IP address has been reached. You can start another audit in {wait}.

PUBLIC_ERROR.sk: Požiadavku sa nepodarilo dokončiť. Skúste to znova.
PUBLIC_ERROR.en: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
